name: Caching & Asynchronous Messaging
description: In-memory caching architectures (Redis, Memcached), caching patterns (Cache-Aside, Write-Through, Write-Behind), cache invalidation and stampede mitigation, message brokers (RabbitMQ), event streaming platforms (Apache Kafka), asynchronous worker queues (Celery, BullMQ), idempotent consumer design, distributed Redis clusters, and stream backpressure control.

subskills.name: In-Memory Caching (Redis/Memcached)
subskills.description: Redis data structures (strings, hashes, sets, sorted sets, bitmaps), TTL expiration policies, cache hit/miss metrics, and basic Memcached usage.

subskills.name: Pub/Sub Messaging Patterns
subskills.description: Publish-subscribe fanout messaging, Redis Pub/Sub channels, event broadcasting across server instances, and decoupled notification systems.

subskills.name: Background Job Queues
subskills.description: Asynchronous job processing frameworks (BullMQ, Celery, Sidekiq, Celery, SQS), worker concurrency, delayed jobs, and automated retries.

subskills.name: Caching Strategies & Patterns
subskills.description: Cache-Aside (lazy loading), Read-Through, Write-Through, and Write-Behind (Write-Back) caching patterns, and trade-offs in consistency vs latency.

subskills.name: Cache Invalidation & Thundering Herd
subskills.description: Cache invalidation techniques, Thundering Herd / Cache Stampede mitigation (mutex locking, probabilistic early expiration), and dogpiling prevention.

subskills.name: Message Queues (RabbitMQ/AMQP)
subskills.description: AMQP protocol, exchanges (Direct, Fanout, Topic, Headers), queues, routing keys, consumer acknowledgements (ACK/NACK), and Dead Letter Exchanges (DLX).

subskills.name: Event Streaming (Apache Kafka)
subskills.description: Kafka topics, partitions, consumer groups, offset commit management, log retention, consumer rebalancing, and exactly-once processing semantics.

subskills.name: Idempotent Consumers & Deduplication
subskills.description: Message deduplication strategies, unique message ID tracking in Redis/DB, idempotency keys, and handling out-of-order message delivery.

subskills.name: Distributed Caching & Redis Cluster
subskills.description: Redis Cluster sharding (hash slots 0-16383), Redis Sentinel high availability and master election, consistent hashing, and eviction policies (LRU, LFU).

subskills.name: Stream Backpressure & Flow Control
subskills.description: Reactive streams, consumer backpressure handling, buffer overflow mitigation, rate matching between producers and consumers, and pause/resume mechanisms.

junior.description: Utilizes Redis for basic key-value caching with TTLs, publishes events to pub/sub channels, and enqueues background worker tasks.

mid.description: Implements cache-aside/write-through patterns, prevents cache stampedes, routes AMQP exchanges/DLXs in RabbitMQ, and consumes Kafka partition topics.

senior.description: Architects resilient idempotent consumers with deduplication, configures multi-node Redis Clusters with Sentinel failovers, and manages stream backpressure flow control.
